title: Compiler, Values, and Narrowing Phase Assessment
description: Comprehensive phase-end assessment covering all lessons in Compiler, Values, and Narrowing.

questions.prompt: Which is the safest beginner application of type inference?

options.text: rely on inference for obvious local values and annotate public boundaries
reassigning an inferred string variable to a number is rejected
Replace the type with any
Use an unchecked assertion at every call

questions.explanation: rely on inference for obvious local values and annotate public boundaries. Confirm compiler behavior with strict mode and a minimal example instead of relying on an assertion.

questions.prompt: Which is the safest beginner application of strict mode?

options.text: enable strict in tsconfig for new application code
disabling strict can hide null and implicit-any defects
Replace the type with any
Use an unchecked assertion at every call

questions.explanation: enable strict in tsconfig for new application code. Confirm compiler behavior with strict mode and a minimal example instead of relying on an assertion.

questions.prompt: Which is the safest beginner application of annotations?

options.text: annotate function boundaries when the contract should remain stable
annotations do not convert values at runtime
Replace the type with any
Use an unchecked assertion at every call

questions.explanation: annotate function boundaries when the contract should remain stable. Confirm compiler behavior with strict mode and a minimal example instead of relying on an assertion.

questions.prompt: Which is the safest beginner application of union types?

options.text: narrow a union before using member-specific operations

Use an unchecked assertion at every call

questions.explanation: narrow a union before using member-specific operations. Confirm compiler behavior with strict mode and a minimal example instead of relying on an assertion.

questions.prompt: Which is the safest beginner application of unknown?

questions.explanation: represent untrusted external data as unknown. Confirm compiler behavior with strict mode and a minimal example instead of relying on an assertion.
